entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: Provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US while enforcing strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and low-bandwidth availability.

entities.name: Patients (EU & US)
entities.description: Patients seeking video consultations, e-prescriptions, and AI symptom checking.

entities.name: Licensed Clinicians
entities.description: Clinicians conducting video consultations and issuing e-prescriptions.

entities.name: EU/US Regional Pharmacies
entities.description: Regional pharmacies fulfilling e-prescriptions using national EU standards and US HL7 FHIR.

entities.name: Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US)
entities.description: Authorities auditing and ensuring compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR.

entities.name: Identity Providers (IDPs)
entities.description: External identity providers handling authentication via OAuth2/OIDC.

entities.name: Third-Party Video Infrastructure
entities.description: WebRTC-compliant SFU/MCU provider supporting adaptive bitrate streaming.

entities.name: API Gateway / BFF
entities.description: Provides API gateway and backend-for-frontend services.

entities.name: Consultation & Prescriptions Service
entities.description: Manages video consultations and prescription logic.

entities.name: E-Prescription Adapter
entities.description: Adapts and communicates with regional pharmacies.

entities.name: AI Symptom Checker Service
entities.description: Provides AI-driven symptom checking for patients.

entities.name: Consent & Privacy Service
entities.description: Manages user consent and privacy compliance.

entities.name: Regional Databases
entities.description: Provides strictly partitioned regional relational databases for data residency compliance.

naming_conventions: Users and actors are designated with plural descriptions reflecting their regional scope (e.g., 'Patients (EU & US)', 'Licensed Clinicians').
External systems and authorities use descriptive compound nouns specifying their domain and geographic region (e.g., 'EU/US Regional Pharmacies', 'Regulatory Authorities / Notified Bodies (EU/US)').
